X-002 / RESEARCHING

Folio: LaTeX IDE concept

A published concept for an IntelliJ-platform LaTeX IDE; the public repository has no source tree yet.

CASE FILENODES · 0SOURCE ↗

Published direction#

The public repository describes a native LaTeX IDE on the IntelliJ Platform, with live preview, project templates, and toolchain-agnostic compilation.

Evidence boundary#

The GitHub API reported an empty repository during this audit. The description establishes an intended direction; it does not establish implemented features, a working build, or a public release. Work stored elsewhere is outside this public-source inventory.

Question#

What project structure, compilation contract, and preview pipeline would turn that concept into a reproducible public artifact?

Next evidence to publish#

A source tree, build instructions, and a minimal example would make the implementation assessable. This Lab entry records the concept as an investigation rather than a completed Work item. Its state describes the public catalog's research stage, not a verified statement about private development activity.

Source#

Public project description.
